Smoke test: XLSX with basic spreadsheet data including tables

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{kind: "uri", mime_type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", uri: "https://example.com/xlsx/stanley_cups.xlsx"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).mime_type)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).content)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).tables)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).metadata.format.excel.sheet_count)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).metadata.format.excel.sheet_names)
```
